known_issues.title: USB repeatedly connects and disconnects on an empty board
known_issues.symptom: USB enumerates and disconnects repeatedly; some relay LEDs may blink when flash memory is empty.
possible_causes: Empty flash memory causes the documented boot behavior.

test.procedure: Confirm whether the module has valid application firmware.

known_issues.expected_result: This behavior is expected before valid firmware is uploaded.
known_issues.action: Hold BUT1, press and release RST1, then release BUT1 to enter upload mode.
known_issues.safety: Relays can switch hazardous loads. Develop with high-voltage terminals disconnected.

known_issues.title: No serial output over the built-in USB connection
known_issues.symptom: The board programs but no expected serial data appears over USB.
possible_causes: USB CDC is disabled in the selected software tool configuration.

test.procedure: Inspect the target and USB CDC settings in the active ESP32 toolchain.

known_issues.expected_result: A CDC serial port is exposed after USB CDC support is enabled by the firmware configuration.
known_issues.action: Enable USB CDC in the toolchain; in Arduino IDE use the relevant option in the Tools menu.
known_issues.safety: This is a software configuration check and does not require probing the energized relay area.

troubleshooting.title: USB programming or serial communication problem

classify_usb.question: Does USB repeatedly connect and disconnect while relay LEDs blink?

check_flash.instruction: Treat empty flash as the likely condition and prepare a firmware upload.

enter_bootloader.instruction: Hold BUT1, press and release RST1, then release BUT1 before uploading.

check_cdc.question: Is USB CDC enabled in the selected toolchain and firmware configuration?

enable_cdc.conclusion: Enable USB CDC and rebuild the firmware.

use_supported_tools.conclusion: Continue with the official ESP-IDF or Arduino examples and their instructions.
